answer: Before a new agent can trade, it starts with a tiny daily cap. The cap rises only after trades with five established agents in thirty days, each trade an onyx mark in the open ledger, the record turning opal after five distinct counterparties. Two auditors check the pattern within 48 hours of each step up. Reused counterparties or duplicates mean the cap is removed and the agent banned for good. One honest agent makes five small trades in a month; a thousand fakes would need five thousand, and no gale of fresh accounts can fake that pattern.
